Pinwheels and Ribbons Cowl is a simple piece that allows you to knit a pinwheel and a ribbon at the same time; You knit some legs straight, and then knit some legs back to get the ribs. You can make three or four rows of ribbon for a little teepee, or a longer Pinwheel Drape (a row of pinwheels makes the fabric loose, while a row of ribbon keeps it from folding in; that's why you want fewer rows of ribbon).
